Gay-szene.net's historic entry advertises wooded paths and an alleged zoo-side carpark evening price, but its dedicated forum contains no date-stamped visitor entries. Dortmund's municipal Rombergpark management and gardens confirm the site as a recreational attraction, not a designated cruising zone. Historical parking tariffs cannot be assumed current.
